runs.name: Sumitomo Corporation
runs.box: TOO HARD (WORK) AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **¥1,708** (TSE 8053 close 2026-10-09; Tokyo shut 2026-10-12) and ADS **$10.84** (close 2026-10-12; USD/JPY 158.68), aggregator, flagged; **1 ADS = 1 share** on Citibank's F-6EF of 2026-06-22 (0001193805-26-000852), the ratio after the four-for-one split of 2026-07-01 checked from the two quotes. Shares **4,738,846,768** post-split (issued 4,780,460,736 less 41,613,968 treasury at 2026-06-30, Q1 FY2026 Tanshin of 2026-07-31; cross-checked to the audited FY2025 Note 20 times four) = cap **¥8,094bn** (about $51.0bn); sovereign **4.136%** (JGB 30Y, Ministry of Finance jgbcme.csv, 2026-10-08). Not an SEC registrant: `tools/run.py` and `cover_shares.py` returned nothing; every figure by hand from the company's English Annual Financial Reports FY2020 to FY2025 (FY2025 statements approved 2026-06-12, KPMG AZSA), the Integrated Reports 2023 to 2026, the FY2022 and FY2023 results presentations and the Q1 FY2026 Tanshin; FY2025 profit ¥600,334M cross-checked against the Integrated Report and the Tanshin, net debt ¥3,147.2bn at March 2026 cross-checked. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from the annual report, as the overnight brief directs. **Q1 IN** on the deciding part: no part carries half; segments reorganised 2024-04-01 and 2026-04-01, so the analyst built the parts table from the company's own Mineral/Non-mineral split excluding one-offs (taking the company's two Mineral definitions as one part, a CONVENTION of the run); Mineral resources decides at about 28% (¥707bn of ¥2,521bn, FY2021 to FY2025), understood by cost position (M2012-065, M2011-014, M2009-059). The analyst set down that on the three restated years alone Transportation & Construction Systems (¥286.6bn, holding the leasing businesses) and Energy Transformation (¥283.1bn) each out-earned Mineral Resources (¥163.9bn), so the deciding part decides on the FY2021-22 commodity peak. **Q2 TOO HARD (WORK)**: a commodity seller at world prices (M1997-010, L2000-017, M2009-059), earning mostly as a minority owner (equity-method ¥60.8bn of ¥82.3bn, FY2025), **no unit cost or cost-curve position disclosed for any producing interest**; the Madagascar nickel venture impaired ¥84.8bn (FY2020, with others), ¥88.7bn (FY2023), ¥18.9bn (FY2024) and transferred May 2026; full-cycle return on assets FY2021-25 about 5.7% against BHP 14.3%, Rio Tinto 12.4%, Freeport 8.4%, Teck 4.1% (mixed bases, read in words); tenuous castle (M2000-019, M2006-013); WORK because the operators' own reports give unit costs and reserves and were not read (M2006-076, M1994-026). Research-pass steps 1 and 2 written, not run (five questions: profit by interest, cost-curve position, reserve life, the remaining portfolio through FY2020 and FY2023 troughs, the trading book; questions 4 and 5 unanswerable send it to NATURE). Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash FY2021-25 averaged ¥309.2bn equity, ¥329.7bn all-equity before purchases (interest add-back at 31.0%, a CONVENTION of the run), ¥66.6bn and ¥87.1bn after net purchases of ¥1,213.0bn (SCSK minority buyout ¥754.2bn), against profit ¥515.5bn; serial-acquirer rule makes the organic pair central, growth set by the cap where no organic rate is filed (a CONVENTION of the run); window growth 74.4% cut to sales growth 7.5% and then to 4.136%; net debt ¥3,713.5bn at 2026-06-30 (after the ~¥330bn aircraft-leasing deal). Range **¥899 to ¥1,594 all-equity central ($5.66 to $10.05 per ADS)** against ¥1,708; equity-only ¥1,578 to ¥2,230; working capital removed ¥1,431 to ¥2,347; default pair negative; 2.8% to 4.0% at the price, so Q7 would have closed OUT on the floor. Fair price beneath the stop **¥26 all-equity ($0.16)**, ¥759 equity-only ($4.78); not armed (box not OUT at Q7). Balance sheets: flat at ¥7.8 to 8.1tn FY2015-19, then to ¥13.6tn; equity up 82%, other components of equity -¥4.1bn to ¥1,255.0bn (translation); inventories 17.1% to 24.3% of revenues and receivables 28.1% to 32.9% since FY2020 (FY2025 receivables +¥385.6bn on revenues +0.6%; FY2025 operating cash includes ¥577.8bn from payables); net debt to equity 0.78; equity-method investments about a quarter of assets. Recorded after the stop, not weighed: an FSA business improvement order of 2025-12-05 to Sumisho Realty Management, the REIT manager, Sumitomo being 'a major provider of properties to the REITs' (flagged in the box line; the order itself not read); buybacks with no price, FY2025 average about ¥1,132 post-split, above the bottom of the computed range; guarantees ¥252.0bn, commitments ¥894.4bn; a commodity derivatives trading book inside the deciding part. Competitors: the company names none; compared against four SEC filers (BHP, Rio Tinto, Freeport, Teck); the other Japanese trading houses not read. Contamination declared by the analyst: the session's recent commit subjects naming the MARUY run, its Q1 and Q2 wording and its TOO HARD (NATURE) box; a memory index line; two research-folder names in the git status; none opened. Commits b9a6f404, 677bf77c, 5111b45a, fc52da8c. Citations: the analyst's check no E-ids, no missing ids; the dispatcher's adjacency script 18 adjacent fragments, 0 slips. Position note filled at the fold. check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the fourth trading house of the day on the commodity question, and a third reading of it: MTSUY stopped at Q1 (NATURE), MARUY at Q2 (NATURE, tenuous castle), ITOCY passed both, and SSUMY stops at Q2 as WORK, on the ground that the cost position is knowable from the operators' filings. The analyst's gaps: (1) the parts rule across a segment reorganisation, and whether an aberrational window year that Q7 (a) moves should also move the parts table; (2) specific (c) presumes a filed organic growth rate; (3) the all-equity basis for a trading or leasing balance sheet (net debt finances receivables, inventory and lease assets; central fair ¥26 against ¥759 equity-only); (4) WORK or NATURE for a commodity producer whose portfolio was reshaped by exits (the change-for-the-better rule can turn a knowable cost question into NATURE after the reading).
runs.narr: Q2 TOO HARD (WORK): a Japanese trading house in ten groups, none with half the profit, so Mineral resources decides at about 28% (on the company's own Mineral/Non-mineral split across two reorganisations); Q1 IN by cost position, but no unit cost is disclosed for any mine, the Madagascar nickel venture was impaired three times and given away, and full-cycle returns sit mid-field against BHP, Rio, Freeport and Teck; the cost position is knowable from the operators' reports, so WORK, research pass written not run. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range ¥899 to ¥1,594 all-equity at the 4.136% JGB against ¥1,708 (2.8% to 4.0% at the price), fair ¥26 all-equity (¥759 equity-only), not armed. After the stop: an FSA order to the REIT-manager subsidiary over conflicts with Sumitomo, working capital outgrowing sales, buybacks above the range's bottom.
